target_bug.title: Dropped lit candlestick does not illuminate the dark room

hints.weak: Explore whether light-producing items keep affecting room visibility when they move between inventory and the room environment.
hints.medium: Focus on light-source state after a lit item leaves the player's inventory. Verify whether a dark room remains illuminated after dropping the lit item there.
hints.strong: In the basement, light the candlestick, drop it, then execute `look`. The likely defect is in `GameWorld.has_light_source`, which only considers inventory-held lit items.

target_bug.hint: Focus on light-source state after a lit item leaves the player's inventory. Verify whether a dark room remains illuminated after dropping the lit item there.
target_bug.expected_behavior: A lit candlestick dropped in the current dark room should continue to illuminate that room.
target_bug.observed_fault: After the lit candlestick is dropped in a dark room, the room remains pitch-black because light-source checks only consider the player's inventory.
reproduction: Pick up the candlestick and matches.
Execute `look` and observe whether the room is still described as pitch-black.

golden_patch.source: gbqa-authored oracle patch for a historical baseline bug; not from v0.1.0..v0.2.0
